Context: 1. Eligibility

While availing AILTC, it is mandatory to commence onward journey on or before 31st December of the calendar year and return journey can be performed in the following calendar year.. In case of last calendar year of a four year blo.ck, onward journey can also be performed on or before 31st December of next calendar year and return journey can be performed in the following calendar year. - OM, dated 16-11-2022..  
- LTC will cover the Government servant and his family.
